info.title: Ds Bit Business API v1 (Contract Candidate)
info.summary: Machine-readable candidate for the Ds Bit <-> Morrishk Business API v1. NOT A FROZEN CONTRACT.
info.description: This document is a CONTRACT CANDIDATE derived from 'Ds Bit <-> Morrishk Business API Integration Design v1' (v1.3) and the Phase 0 decisions IQ-01 / IQ-02 / IQ-13 registered on 2026-11-17. It is NOT frozen, NOT approved for implementation, and MUST NOT be treated as the production contract. Blocking open questions (IQ-05, IQ-09, IQ-15, IQ-21) and the pending MpnNormalizer freeze are listed in x-open-blockers. Server URLs are placeholders and MUST NOT be called: no production Business API exists.

contact.name: Morrishk x Ds Bit integration (Session B)

tags.name: auth
tags.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (RFC 6749); not part of the JSON envelope.

tags.name: products
tags.description: Product business DTO, identity, gating status, versions, evidence.

tags.name: taxonomy
tags.description: Technical taxonomy, category nodes, edges, versions and changes.

post.description: Returns an opaque Bearer token. Response uses RFC 6749 fields, NOT the JSON envelope. Credentials are sent via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic). Production credentials are out of scope for this candidate and are not authorized.

scope.description: Space-separated scope list. Must be a subset of the client's registration.

get.summary: Search products, MPN exact lookup, and incremental sync
get.description: Default filter is release_state=RELEASED and identity_state=CONFIRMED. Exact MPN lookup REQUIRES brand; missing brand returns 422 PRODUCT_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE. The REVOKED stream MUST be supported so consumers can discover withdrawals.

Returns RELEASE_APPROVED data only by default. Existing-but-unreleased returns 403 PRODUCT_NOT_RELEASED (never 404). A revoked release returns 410 PRODUCT_RELEASE_REVOKED and consumers must stop public display.
Returns pipeline / content / release gate states plus derived visible_state. Requires product.publish.read.
Version metadata only; never returns unpublished parameter values beyond what the caller's scope allows.
Returns evidence references and short raw text only. Screenshot paths are local relative paths, not download URLs. Public download is OPEN (IQ-08).

Also gated by product release state. Unreleased product returns 403 PRODUCT_NOT_RELEASED. Internal read requires BOTH product.category.read and product.publish.read plus internal_only=true; otherwise 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE.
get.x-special-gate: Unreleased product => 403 PRODUCT_NOT_RELEASED; internal_only without product.publish.read => 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE

get.description: Only PUBLISHED taxonomies and, during retention, DEPRECATED ones are visible.

get.summary: Get taxonomy version and ETag for sync pre-check

get.description: mode=flat is paginated. mode=tree is capped at depth 4 and 5000 nodes; exceeding it returns 413 TREE_TOO_LARGE and the caller must fall back to flat + incremental.
V1_OPTIONAL: required if Phase 0 decides that merge/split must be detected automatically.

get.summary: Get a category node with parent/child references
get.description: DRAFT/REVIEWED categories return 403 CATEGORY_NOT_PUBLISHED. DEPRECATED categories remain readable during retention and carry merged_into/split_into; after retention they return 410 CATEGORY_RETIRED (retention window is OPEN, IQ-05).

get.summary: List direct children of a category

get.description: V1_OPTIONAL: derivable from path_ids, but saves requests when breadcrumb names are needed.
V1_OPTIONAL: Morrishk can reverse-lookup locally to avoid large lists.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 Client Credentials. Opaque Bearer token, expires_in=900s, refresh when <=120s remain, revocation propagation ceiling 60s. Scopes are additive and never implicitly downgrade.

scopes.product.category.read: Taxonomy and category reads, including product-category edges; excludes product parameters
scopes.product.evidence.read: Evidence references and short raw text; no PDF binary
scopes.product.publish.read: Unreleased gate status and internal-only data

ProductBusinessKey.name: product_business_key
ProductBusinessKey.description: Deterministic key derived from (mpn_norm, brand_norm). Not a document id and not an internal platform id.

Mpn.name: mpn
Mpn.description: Raw MPN. Normalized by the server with MpnNormalizer; the client must NOT pre-normalize.

MpnMatch.name: mpn_match
MpnMatch.description: loose remains OPEN (IQ-20) and is not enabled by default in v1.

ReleaseStateFilter.name: release_state
ReleaseStateFilter.description: REVOKED and PENDING require product.publish.read. NOTE: this is a filter namespace, distinct from release gate state and visible_state; reconciliation is OPEN.

InternalOnly.name: internal_only
InternalOnly.description: Requires BOTH product.category.read and product.publish.read. Must not be silently ignored.

StatusFilter.name: status
StatusFilter.description: DRAFT/REVIEWED are never exposed to business clients.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor; clients must not parse or construct it.

ETag.description: Strong ETag = SHA-256 of canonical JSON

NotModified.description: If-None-Match matched. No body. Not an error.

Gone.description: 410 PRODUCT_RELEASE_REVOKED / CATEGORY_RETIRED. Not retryable. PRODUCT_RELEASE_REVOKED forbids cache-based display.

PayloadTooLarge.description: 413 TREE_TOO_LARGE - fall back to flat + incremental

ProductBusinessKey.description: pbk1_ + 64 lowercase hex chars (full SHA-256). 69 chars total. Encoding is PROPOSED and must be frozen.

VisibleState.description: Derived display state from the three gates. Enum reconciliation with release_state is OPEN (VISIBLE-STATE-RECONCILIATION).

code.description: 0 on success; stable business error code otherwise

children.description: Only present in mode=tree, capped at depth 4 / 5000 nodes.
Compact child references, max 200; use /children for full pagination.
